archetypes.name: dyn-scope-closure
archetypes.rationale: Conditional section boundaries and eager-wins dedup now decide ratcheted closure membership.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the skill closure scanner changes that split eager and conditional markdown references. Focus on design heading scope, step-comment boundary closure, and eager-wins removal from conditional_files. Check whether real design references such as plan-review.md stay eager while branch-only references move to conditional. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-runtime-operands
archetypes.rationale: Runtime markdown operands are intentionally skipped only for conditional harvesting.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review runtime operand handling in the closure scanner. Verify that conditional clauses safely ignore $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR and other runtime markdown paths while still collecting repo-relative references in the same directive. Check that eager directives with only runtime markdown operands still fail closed rather than disappearing. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
